fields.label: Please specify your enquiry type
fields.hint: Please describe your enquiry type in a few words.

fields.content: For technical support, include your Prism version number, a URL, or any error messages you're seeing. This helps us resolve your issue faster.

fields.label: Tell us more
fields.hint: Please be as specific as possible — the more detail you give, the faster we can help.

fields.content: Do not include passwords, API keys, or other sensitive credentials in your message. Our support team does not need this information.
